answer: The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in reef, expire in lotus, and oasis lists each expiry. An adversary running 126 aliases therefore needs 51 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1392 identities would post 3835 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
